verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no API versioning scheme (e.g. /v1 paths, version headers) and no published deprecation or sunset policy for Supabase's APIs. The Management API OpenAPI spec and pinning the CLI version as an npm dev dependency are adjacent: they describe or pin tooling but do not establish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
